comment: PLN-725 v1 signal taxonomy. Fixed vocabulary — signal-extraction agents cannot invent new names. Adding a signal requires editing this file intentionally (Phase 9 will mirror the taxonomy into bootstrap's agent-decomposer so the two stay in sync). Per-signal recommended_min_confidence is the floor a coverage rule should apply when not overridden in critic-gates.json.

framework_react.description: React-specific code present (JSX/TSX components, hooks, react imports).

framework_vue.description: Vue single-file components or Vue API usage.

framework_next.description: Next.js conventions (pages/, app/, getServerSideProps, server actions).

auth_touching.description: Authentication, session, or credential code touched (login flows, token issuance, password handling).

crypto_primitives.description: Cryptographic primitives invoked or configured (hashing, signing, KDF, key generation, cipher choice).

pii_handling.description: Code that handles personally identifiable information (email, SSN, phone, address, financial identifiers).

data_mutating.description: Code that mutates persisted state (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, ORM .save/.delete, file writes to shared storage).

schema_change.description: Database schema modified (migration files, model field changes, index changes).

external_io.description: Filesystem, OS, or external resource I/O introduced or changed beyond within-process logic.

network_callout.description: Outbound HTTP/RPC/queue call introduced or modified (fetch, axios, requests, gRPC clients, SQS publishes).

concurrency_changes.description: Concurrency primitives touched (locks, mutexes, async coordination, worker pools, threadpools).

state_management_changes.description: Shared client-state stores touched (Redux, Zustand, Pinia, NgRx, Vuex).

caching_changes.description: Cache layer touched (Redis, Memcached, in-process LRU, HTTP cache headers).

realtime_changes.description: Real-time transport touched (WebSocket, SSE, long-poll, pub/sub).

feature_flag_change.description: Feature flag added/removed/toggled (LaunchDarkly, GrowthBook, Unleash, internal flag stores).

config_change.description: Application configuration changed (env defaults, settings modules, runtime config endpoints).

new_external_dependency.description: New third-party package added (package.json, requirements.txt, Cargo.toml, go.mod, Gemfile).

dependency_version_change.description: Existing dependency version upgraded or downgraded.

build_pipeline_change.description: Build, bundler, or transpiler configuration touched (webpack, vite, tsconfig, babel, esbuild, Makefile).

infrastructure_change.description: Infrastructure-as-code touched (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, Kubernetes manifests, Helm).

migration_irreversible.description: A schema or data migration that cannot be cleanly rolled back (DROP COLUMN, data backfill without snapshot).

exported_symbol_change.description: A diff modifies the surface of an exported symbol: function/method signature (added/removed/reordered params, return type change), exported type definition (interface/type alias fields), exported class API (method added/removed/visibility-changed), exported constant value or type, schema field (migration column, GraphQL field, proto message). Triggers FEA-1401 Impact Analyzer when --depth deep.

symbol_deletion.description: A diff removes an exported symbol: deleted function/method/class/constant/type. The highest-confidence Impact Analyzer trigger because deletion always breaks every external caller. Triggers FEA-1401 Impact Analyzer when --depth deep.

accessibility_relevant.description: Interactive UI surface where a11y review is warranted (aria attributes, focus management, semantic HTML, form labels).

i18n_relevant.description: User-facing strings or formatting paths touched (translation lookups, date/number formatters, RTL handling).

performance_sensitive.description: Hot-path code or scaling-sensitive logic touched (loops over large collections, query plans, render commits).

observability_changes.description: Logging/metrics/tracing surface touched (logger calls, span creation, metric emission, error reporting).
